validity.value: Photographs must have been taken within the past six months

cross_verification.note_en: Source is the High Commission of the Kingdom of Lesotho in the UK (lesothohc.org.uk, an official Lesotho diplomatic mission), directly fetched. Under the Business Visa documentation checklist it states: 'Two (2) coloured passport size photographs taken within the past six months.' This confirms colour (not B&W), a 2-photo count, and a 6-month recency window, but does not give exact millimeter dimensions, background colour, or facial-composition rules. Lesotho's homeaffairs.gov.ls e-Visa system was also checked directly and found to display only 'eVISA Applications System Suspended' with no photo specification published at the time of this research. Exact size/background/head-height are therefore left unverified rather than filled from unofficial visa-agency sites.
